defs.def: to form a picture in your mind of what sth might be like 想像；设想

ex.s: Imagine there is a fence along a road.
ex.t: 想象一条路旁有一道栅栏。

ex.s: We can imagine a different version of King Robert’s story.
ex.t: 我们可以想象罗伯特国王故事的另一个版本。

ex.s: She has served here for 17 years and can’t imagine working anywhere else.
ex.t: 她在这里工作17年了，无法想象去别的地方工作。

ex.s: Flowers are everywhere-hanging baskets, window boxes, and planters-just what you imagine in an attractive English market town.
ex.t: 鲜花处处可见——悬挂花篮、窗台花箱和花盆——正是你想象中迷人英国集镇的样子。

ex.s: They might just be imagining the next great idea.
ex.t: 他们可能正在构思下一个伟大的想法。

ex.s: In Newton’s era, we imagined the universe as a clock.
ex.t: 在牛顿的时代，我们把宇宙想象成一座钟。

ex.s: But I imagine that, while money is indeed wonderful and necessary, rereading an author’s work is the highest currency a reader can pay them.
ex.t: 但我想，虽然金钱确实美好且必不可少，但重读一位作者的作品，是读者能给予他们的最高回报。

ex.s: Imagine a child standing on a diving board four feet high and asking himself the question:“Should I jump?
ex.t: 想象一个孩子站在四英尺高的跳水板上问自己一个问题："我应该跳下去吗？

ex.s: So imagine my   42   when he emailed me saying he wanted to come to visit me.
ex.t: 所以想想他发邮件说想来看望我时，我该有多么惊讶吧。

ex.s: “I can’t imagine doing anything else with my life.” Bridges runs dance classes for all ages.
ex.t: “我无法想象在生活中做其他任何事情。”布里奇斯为所有年龄段的人开设舞蹈课。

ex.s: In 1928 Herbert Hoover imagined an America with “a chicken in every pot and a car in every garage.” Since then, this society has moved onward, never looking back, as the car transformed America from a farm-based society into an industrial power.zxx.k
ex.t: 1928年，赫伯特·胡佛设想了一个“每个锅里一只鸡、每个车库一辆车”的美国。从那以后，这个社会一往无前，从不回头，因为汽车把美国从一个以农业为基础的社会变成了一个工业强国。

ex.s: Imagine a future where most adults own individual self-driving vehicles.
ex.t: 想象一个未来，多数成年人拥有各自的自动驾驶汽车。

defs.def: to believe sth that is not true 误以为；胡乱猜想；猜测

ex.s: We are repeatedly willing to imagine we have found most of what is left to discover.
ex.t: 我们总是一厢情愿地以为，所剩待发现的东西大都已经被我们找到。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: They found it hard to answer, she wrote later, because imagining something that isn’t part of real life—and learning how to make it real—is a rare skill.
ex.t: 她后来写道，他们发现很难回答，因为想象不属于真实生活的东西——并学会如何让它成真——是一种罕见的能力。

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: “我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片，”他对《中国日报》说，“但你可以想象，过一阵子后，你收到的永远不会和你寄出的一样多，你会意识到不是每个人都像你一样热衷于它____32____”不过，为了寻找其他志同道合的人，保罗开始在一个不太可能的地方寻找：网上。

ex.s: Imagine that a police officer is chasing a thief.
ex.t: 想象一名警察正在追一个小偷。

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。

ex.s: We could also say Imagine that in spring the mountains are covered bv strips of water, which shine brightly in the sun.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，想象春天里群山被条带状的水田覆盖，在阳光下闪闪发亮。

defs.def: to think that sth is probably true 料想；认为

ex.s: I would never have imagined that this could happen nowadays.
ex.t: 我从未想过这种事竟然会在当今发生。

ex.s: Understanding ideas (two pictures) (picture 1) Zhuang people (picture 2) Yao people Longji Rice Terraces 1 Imagine mountains wrapped in silver water, shining in the spring sun.
ex.t: 理解思路：想象群山被银色的水包裹，在春天的阳光下闪闪发光。

ex.s: Her head and arms are missing, but you can imagine her holding her arms up high, celebrating the result of an ancient battle.
ex.t: 她的头和手臂不见了，但你可以想象她高举双臂，庆祝一场古老战斗的胜利。

ex.s: Now, my favourite one I can imagine!
ex.t: 现在，我能想象的最喜欢的一个！
